app.js:12 Notes cannot be opened or deleted by keyboard: list rows and the delete control are not focusable, and delete is hover-only. Rows are plain li with a delegated click handler (app.js:30-33); the delete control is a div with an inline onclick (app.js:12) and styles.css:12 sets it to opacity 0 until :hover, so touch users cannot see it either. app.js:10 list.innerHTML += inside the loop re-parses and rebuilds the whole list on every iteration. Each iteration re-serialises and re-parses the existing DOM, which is quadratic and wasteful. It also discards state on existing nodes. Build one string and assign it once.

app.js:25 Delete is immediate and irreversible: no confirmation, no undo. app.js:23-28 removes the note and persists in one step; the delete control is a small icon revealed on hover (styles.css:12) sitting inside the row that opens the note.
